relationships.subject: LS GABAergic-LH circuit
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed activation of LS projections to HDB and LH reduced time spent in OFT center, EPM open arms and entries in open arms

relationships.subject: LS GABAergic-LH circuit
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, the activation of the LS to LH projection had an effect on the pain threshold, the projection of LS to HDB did not change the pain threshold

relationships.subject: LS-PAG projection
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of LS projections to PAG also reduced pain thresholds but did not induce anxiety-like behavior

key_findings: LS GABAergic neurons are activated in CFA pain and chronic restraint stress; their activation induces hyperalgesia and anxiety-like behavior while inhibition or ablation reverses both.
The LS GABAergic projection to the lateral hypothalamus regulates comorbid pain and anxiety.
